preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The root must be either None or an instance of TreeNode.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or isinstance(node.nextRight, TreeNode) for node in traverse_tree(root))
postconditions.description: All nextRight pointers must point to either None or another TreeNode.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or (node.nextRight == next(node) for node in traverse_tree(root)))
postconditions.description: Each node's nextRight pointer must correctly point to the next node at the same level.
